Lowering turns a cross-file import or call occurrence into an exact foreign declaration target (pass_native_tsz_occurrences, native_tsz_import_declaration_coordinate, which handles class, interface, alias, enum, module, variable and function targets and is unchanged), and tests a6231d67d and 29a3954ff pin that a cross-file call keeps an exact foreign callee coordinate and caller. The arithmetic above is from the logged view dump, not from the fixture source.

The attribution of the 205 rows to that publication is by exact count partition and by the absence of any other changed row class, not by a code path read end to end. An earlier hypothesis that the 208 anonymous callable rows explain the count was checked and rejected: anonymous callables exist in canonical's snapshot and code.
